scope: Real battle initiation and Hyper Escape movement: one/two ships, limited Force, no Force, out of range, no destination, either battle initiator, carried crew/weapons.
method: Board placement and Force counts are controlled fixtures. Battle initiation, card play, nested costs, movement and Used disposition execute through actual GEMP decisions.
Six complete outcomes agree with native replay. Two official-rule divergences are explicitly asserted rather than described as conformance.
Native command replay verifies serialization, state immutability and both seat projections.
Carrying row explicitly checks retained crew/weapon attachments and that the ship, but not its carried crew, used a regular move.

divergences.gemp: Pinned GEMP does not offer Hyper Escape. Its movableAsMoveAway target filter requires an immediately legal, affordable move.
divergences.native: Official AR70–71 permits initiating when a destination exists, ignoring range/affordability. Interrupt resolves to Used but no ship moves and no movement Force is spent.
divergences.authority: AR70 initiation bullets and AR71 Example 1 explicitly demonstrate out-of-range Hyper Escape.

limitations: System movement only. Sector topology and vehicle sector movement remain required before complete Hyper Escape card admission.

Orbit transfers, Sense cancellation, individual move cancellation, changed restrictions, stale instances, no new arrivals, regular-move limits and service refresh have native checks; they are not claimed as additional executed GEMP rows.
